institutions.name: Khalifa University of Science and Technology

requirement.applicantContext: IB Diploma applicants to undergraduate programmes for Fall 2027.
requirement.subjectNotes: Complete the full IB Diploma with six approved HL or SL subjects at grade 4 or above in each. Exclude Islamic Education. Take Mathematics and a science accepted by the intended programme.
requirement.conditions: This university-wide eligibility minimum applies alongside the high-school subject combination specified for the degree and KU’s English requirement. Selection is competitive.
